instruction: Create an image of the current video display and place it in the Documents folder as 'video_snapshot.png'.

parameters.window_name: Interstellar Movie - Interstellar Movie - Official Trailer - VLC media player

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires taking a video snapshot and saving it to Documents folder (different from Desktop). Evaluator checks: (1) file exists, (2) file is located in Documents folder (path verification), (3) file is valid PNG format. This variation tests ability to save files to different system folders.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all three key requirements: file existence (40%), location in Documents folder (40%), and PNG format validation (20%)
Getter logic correctly extracts file state using env.controller.get_file() and validates PNG format using PIL Image.verify()
Metric scoring logic correctly maps to the scoring breakdown in metadata
Path checking logic correctly handles both '/Documents/' substring and '/home/user/Documents/' prefix

Minor limitation: evaluator cannot verify that PNG actually contains a video snapshot (vs any arbitrary PNG), but this is a practical limitation in OSWorld context where pixel-level content verification is not feasible
The evaluator checks all verifiable aspects of the task completion within practical constraints
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding image dimension checks to ensure the snapshot has reasonable dimensions (e.g., > 100x100 pixels)
Consider checking file size to ensure it's not an empty or trivially small PNG
